 Deco to watch €60m Aston Villa star as potential transfer target for Barcelona
 Published
 5 hours ago on
 03/11/2026 
 By
 Swapnil Bhopatkar 
 Photo by Matthew Lewis/Getty Images 
 Comment 
 Tweet 
 Barcelona have identified Aston Villa midfielder Johan Manzambi as a player of interest, with sporting director Deco expected to assess the Switzerland international closely when the two sides meet in the Champions League on Tuesday.
 According to a report from SPORT , the 21-year-old has emerged as one of the players particularly admired by Barcelona’s sporting department. 
 His impressive performances since arriving in the Premier League have attracted attention, although any attempt to bring him to Catalonia would require a significant financial commitment.
 Manzambi has registered three goals and four assists in eight appearances this season, averaging a goal contribution every 70 minutes. 
 With Aston Villa visiting the Spotify Camp Nou later today, Deco will have an opportunity to evaluate a midfielder whose development could make him an attractive candidate for Barcelona’s future recruitment plans.
 Deco set to assess Manzambi during Barcelona vs Aston Villa
 Barcelona will get to observe Johan Manzambi later today. (Photo by Stu Forster/Getty Images) 
 Manzambi’s emergence has been rapid, with his performances for Freiburg last season establishing him as one of Europe’s most exciting young midfield talents.
 The Swiss international registered seven goals and nine assists during his breakthrough campaign in Germany, while also receiving UEFA’s Europa League Revelation of the Season award for 2025-26. 
 His performances also translated onto the international stage, as Manzambi scored three goals and provided two assists for Switzerland at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
 As a result, Barcelona’s interest has developed alongside his continued progression in the Premier League, making Tuesday’s Champions League encounter an opportunity for Deco to observe.
 Aston Villa’s €60 million investment makes transfer difficult
 Aston Villa moved to secure Manzambi’s services from Freiburg in 2026, completing a transfer for approximately €60 million, with additional payments potentially taking the overall package higher.
 Barcelona have Johan Manzambi on their agenda (Photo by Stu Forster/Getty Images) 
 The investment alone makes a future departure particularly complicated, while Manzambi is also under a long-term contract at Villa Park.
 Indeed, his current production makes Barcelona’s interest understandable. 
 Registering seven goal contributions in eight appearances is an impressive return for a midfielder, although those numbers also strengthen Aston Villa’s negotiating position.
 This means Barcelona must have concrete financial backing if they are indeed serious about signing the 21-year-old, who joined Villa in 2026.
